# Profit and Wonder

> Profit and Wonder is a YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/@profitandwonder) that explains how business works: prices, brands, ads, search and the companies behind the things we buy, with 3D motion graphics. Each video page below answers one question in plain words, with the full transcript and a list of sources.

## Videos

- [How much does it cost to make a €2,600 Dior bag?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/dior-bag/): A Milan court found a workshop could make a Dior bag for Dior for as little as €53. Dior sold that bag for €2,600.
- [Does McDonald's make more money from rent than from burgers?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/mcdonalds-landlord/): In 2025, restaurant owners paid McDonald's $10.4 billion in rent. The restaurants McDonald's runs itself sold $9.7 billion of food.
- [What is a bond, and why do bond prices fall when rates rise?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/how-bonds-work/): A bond is an IOU you can sell. When rates rise, old bonds sell for less; when rates fall, for more.
- [Why did New Coke flop if people liked the taste better?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/new-coke-taste-test/): Coke's taste tests measured flavour, not feeling. People loved the new taste but hated losing their Coke, and the original was back in 79 days.
- [Why did Google punish J.C. Penney?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/jcpenney-two-hours/): In 2011 a reporter found 2,015 pages linking to J.C. Penney. Google said they broke its rules, and Penney fell from first to 71st.
- [How do Google's AI answers hurt its own ad business?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/google-seo-war/): Google's ads live on your click. Its AI answers keep the click on Google, and its founders saw the problem in 1998.
- [Why do green text bubbles keep people on iPhone?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/buy-your-mom-an-iphone/): Android texts show up green on iPhone. Tim Cook's answer to that was five words: buy your mom an iPhone.
- [Why is it so hard to leave Apple?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/apple-frictionless-prison/): Apple takes away the friction on the way in and leaves it at the exit: your watch, your messages, your group chat.
- [How did ChatGPT get so popular without ads?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/chatgpt-product-ad/): ChatGPT ran its first TV ad over two years after launch. Its users spread it first, one screenshot at a time.
- [How did ChatGPT get so popular so fast?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/chatgpt-marketing/): Most of ChatGPT's technology wasn't new. The marketing was: five moves, from a small promise to a free-to-paid price ladder.
- [Why does Rolls-Royce show its cars next to private jets?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/rolls-royce-contrast/): A price feels big or small next to what you saw just before it. Next to a jet, a Rolls-Royce looks cheap.
- [What is the difference between marketing and branding?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/marketing-vs-branding/): Marketing is everything that gets you to buy. Branding is the part that makes you remember, so you pick it again.
- [Why do prices end in .99?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/charm-pricing/): We read prices left to right, so $9.99 feels like $9, not $10. That's the left-digit effect, and it sells more.
- [Why does Coca-Cola still advertise if everyone knows it?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/coke-still-advertises/): Buyers forget. Coca-Cola spends $5.4 billion a year on ads to stay easy to think of, and sells everywhere to stay easy to buy.
- [Why does the medium popcorn exist?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/decoy-effect/): The medium popcorn is a decoy: an option nobody wants that makes the large look like a bargain. That's the decoy effect.
- [Do people still click on links when Google shows an AI answer?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/google-ai-answers/): Far fewer do. Pew found link clicks fell from 15% to 8% of visits when an AI summary appeared on top.
- [Why does IKEA make you build your own furniture?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/ikea-effect/): Flat-pack began to cut cost and transport. The bonus: we value things more when we build them ourselves, as long as we finish.
- [What is a marketing funnel and why does it leak?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/leaky-funnel/): Buyers go through steps: attention, interest, desire, action. People drop out at every step, so fix the biggest leak first.
- [Why does losing hurt more than winning?](https://profitandwonder.com/v/loss-aversion/): Your brain weighs a loss about twice as much as the same gain. It's called loss aversion, and ads use it.

## Topics

- [Pricing psychology](https://profitandwonder.com/t/pricing-psychology/): Why prices look the way they do, and the small tricks that change what we pay.
- [Buyer psychology](https://profitandwonder.com/t/buyer-psychology/): How our brains decide what to buy, and how brands use that.
- [Brands and ads](https://profitandwonder.com/t/brands-and-ads/): How big brands get remembered, and what their ads are really for.
- [Google and search](https://profitandwonder.com/t/google-and-search/): How Google decides what you see, and who gets the click.
- [Apple](https://profitandwonder.com/t/apple/): How Apple designs, packages and keeps its customers.
- [AI and marketing](https://profitandwonder.com/t/ai-and-marketing/): How AI products spread, and how AI is changing search and ads.
- [Funnels and growth](https://profitandwonder.com/t/funnels-and-growth/): How a business turns strangers into customers, and where it loses them.
- [Money and markets](https://profitandwonder.com/t/money-and-markets/): How money, debt and markets work, in plain words.
